game.name: Ringshift
game.pitch: In Ringshift you rotate concentric rings. Each ring carries beam sources that fire straight through the centre, and a puzzle is solved when every lock on the outer rim is lit at the same time.
game.mechanics_line: A ring's own pieces never affect its own beam, so every mirror, portal or prism on it only matters for the other rings' beams. Prisms split a beam in two, and an echo sends a copy through its paired mouth, so one source can light two locks.
game.craft_line: I hand-author the Easy, Normal and Hard puzzle ladders and check every level against the game's own engine logic before it becomes playable.
game.demo_line: The demo is free on itch.io and runs in the browser, with nothing to install:
game.hook: a game about steering beams through rotating rings

youtube._help: Free tier: 10,000 quota units a day. search.list costs 100 units, channels.list 1 per 50 channels, and reading a channel's latest uploads 2 (playlistItems.list + videos.list). feed_checks_per_run caps how many search-found channels get that upload check (researched channels in sources.json always do). YouTube's robots.txt blocks its RSS feeds, so nothing is read from youtube.com itself. A query is a string (most relevant first) or {"q": ..., "order": "date"} (newest first).
